clips.title: The story
paras: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable is a Peacekeeper bounty targeting a monstrous winged beast terrorizing the Shen'dar Highlands. Issued by Constable Aonda, the contract calls for adventurers to slay the ravenous vuldren and present her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

A formal bounty posted by Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers marks Vulgara the Insatiable as an immediate danger to the highlands. The massive winged vuldren has terrorized travelers and local settlements from her roost southwest of Shen'dar Village, prompting local authorities to call on adventurous bounty hunters to bring her reign to an end.

The Peacekeepers already find themselves besieged on multiple fronts, struggling to manage threats from regional bandits and a shadowy cult operating in the area. Eliminating Vulgara relieves critical pressure on the local populace, ensuring the skies over Shen'dar remain safe while defenders focus on civil defense.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.
Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
